rail_regional.notes: Single tickets without Deutschlandticket. ~€6 at 30km, ~€12 at 80km, ~€18 at 150km

flight_domestic.notes: Domestic German flights (shorter, proportionally more expensive). ~€90 at 400km, ~€110 at 600km

car_share.notes: Matches MILES Basis's real per-km rate (mobility_catalog.json base_km_rate_eur), the pay-per-use tier this curve represents as the no-subscription baseline. Previously 0.35 — a rate no real car-sharing service charges, which made every paid MILES tier's per-km discount structurally unable to ever beat the unsubscribed default. ~€7.90 at 10km, ~€39.50 at 50km (before per-trip unlock/protection fees, applied separately in tools.py:apply_subscription_discount).

car_rental.notes: Daily rental + fuel, amortized per km. ~€80 at 200km, ~€140 at 400km

car_private.notes: Fuel + wear (no purchase cost). Linear at ~€0.30/km
